query:
SELECT 
  u.id as user_id,
  u.email,
  u.name,
  u.role,
  COUNT(o.id) as office_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sanad_offices o ON u.id = o.ownerId
WHERE u.email = 'luxsess2001@gmail.com'
GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.name, u.role
